target_year_over_year_context.explanation: Both sides cover the goodwill balance, allocation to reporting units, and impairment testing results. D086 details the $4.4B/$4.4B carrying amounts and $59M increase (S001-S003), while D087 confirms no impairment (S004). D077 combines the $5.2B/$4.4B amounts, $758M increase (S001-S003), and no impairment conclusion (S004).

previous_disclosures.summary: As of January 28, 2024, total goodwill was $4.4 billion, allocated as $4.1 billion to Compute & Networking and $370 million to Graphics, compared to $4.0 billion and $370 million respectively in the prior year, with a $59 million increase in FY2024 from an immaterial acquisition allocated to Compute & Networking.
The company completed annual qualitative impairment tests during the fourth quarters of fiscal years 2024, 2023, and 2022, concluding that goodwill was not impaired in any of those periods.

current_disclosures.summary: As of January 26, 2025, total goodwill was $5.2 billion, allocated between Compute & Networking ($4.8 billion) and Graphics ($370 million), with a $758 million increase in fiscal 2025 from acquisitions; the company concluded that goodwill was not impaired in fiscal years 2025, 2024, and 2023.

materiality_analysis.reason: Goodwill increased by $758 million in FY2025, driven by acquisitions, compared to a $59 million increase in FY2024. The allocation to the Compute & Networking unit and the scale of the increase represent a material change in the company's asset base and acquisition activity.
materiality_analysis.key_change: Substantial increase in goodwill balance due to acquisitions

comparisons.peer_summary: The Company conducted annual qualitative impairment tests for goodwill in the fourth quarters of fiscal years 2024 and 2023 and concluded that there was no goodwill impairment for its reporting units.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and AMD conducted annual qualitative impairment tests for goodwill in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2024 and concluded that no impairment existed. NVDA performed tests for fiscal years 2022, 2023, and 2024, while AMD performed tests for 2023 and 2024; both explicitly stated that goodwill was not impaired with respect to their reporting units.

sentences.text: During the fourth quarters of fiscal years 2024, 2023, and 2022, we completed our annual qualitative impairment tests and concluded that goodwill was not impaired.

During the fourth quarter of fiscal years 2024 and 2023, the Company conducted its annual qualitative impairment tests of goodwill and concluded that there was no goodwill impairment with respect to its reporting units.
